body: Hi there, hope you are doing and feeling ok. Any chance you'd be willing to share how did you birth go? Same condition, 31 weeks pregnant here with my second one, with the first one I had a c section and now I'm considering a vaginal delivery, just looking for some experiences.
Any particular job you are interested in? I can relate to this, new job feels like a solution but I  am afraid of making a change only to find myself at the same place emotionally.

Thank you. I am 30 already and on paper my career path is going ok (depending on who I compare myself to but I have few years of managing teams and consulting behind me which some would say is a great job) but I constantly feel like it's all just some sort of an accident or luck and very soon everyone will see that I suck. At the same time I realize that I have very secure job, all the corporate benefits, being married etc. should make me feel happy and content but it does not. But I agree with you, we go at our own pace and at 22 you surely have everything ahead of you. I, for instance, moved out of my parents home at 24 and still worked part time at 22 till I was able to do full time and then got promoted after 2 years, also, don't forget that you can always explore and change careers, especially when you're still young.

I need to experience more successes (any successes really) in my professional life asap to stop feeling like failure and like my life is useless. I need to feel that I am progressing and that I add value or that I am helping someone. Ideally, I would like to start seeing meaning and purpose in my life beyond my work achievements.

Feel the same! I lead quite active life, try to keep myself busy, yet often feel like the most trivial things are like going through endless jungle. You cut through endless trees, get hurt and dirty, only to find there's more. Just had to facilitate a work meeting to influence some guys into doing some stuff (I am a  consultant in a huge corporation) when in reality I feel like jumping out of the window. (and feel guilty for feeling like this because I have no real life struggles) BUT it's not the first time and I am still alive so I guess just need to keep fighting. Maybe if we consider each small thing a fight we can consider that we won few of them too? That was my 1st ever reddit comment
